first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests simplification can improve both completion and durable first-week activation. I would verify the two onboarding records and compare them with the promotional-pricing evidence, especially its downstream retention, margin, and revenue-quality effects, before committing the single experiment slot.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. This directly addresses the 4% completion decline and likely helps the related activation decline. The strongest source evidence showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%. SMB signup simplification also produced activation +9% and qualified revenue +4%, though its 1% retention decline warrants retention and qualified-revenue guardrails. Reject promotional pricing because the verified cohort had 30-day retention -12% and failed to survive first renewal, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
